question: According to Hebrews 9:12, by what means did Christ enter the Most Holy Place once for all?
options: By the blood of goats and calves
By the ashes of a heifer
By the blood of a lamb
explanation: Hebrews 9:12 says Christ did not enter by means of the blood of goats and calves; he entered the Most Holy Place once for all by his own blood, obtaining eternal redemption.
